source.check: names read from the Portadown Times page image, which lists the members returned unopposed by name and address but not by division; each is placed in the division he or she held in 1958, or (the six new members) in the division of the member the Portadown News says he replaced; returned unopposed, no poll

note: Triennial election of the county council, 1961: nominations closed 16 May 1961; 21 of the 22 seats returned unopposed and one contest, Crossmaglen, polled 1 June 1961. The unopposed list prints no party labels. Returned unopposed. Albert E. Houston replaced R. J. Brown (Portadown News, 26 May 1961, p. 1). Unionist nominee: Lurgan Mail, 12 May 1961, p. 3 (the three Lurgan Unionist branches nominated Mrs. D. McNabb, M.P., and Albert E. Houston).
